You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams. This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.   Annual gross salary range (package): €55,000 – €65,000 This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.   Why Now, Why Mirakl Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis. At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products. You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it. What You'll Do 1. Design & Build AI Systems Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations. Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks. Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails. Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems. 2. Integrate Across the Stack Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company. Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases. Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows. Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack. 3. Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements. Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices. 5. Drive Adoption & Enablement Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers. Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations. Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company. Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Annual gross salary range (package): €55,000 – €65,000
This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration and efficiency, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, Bazel, npm, and Python, with support for additional build tools coming soon. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as DuckDuckGo, Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.  Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.  Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results. Who You Are We are looking for a hardworking, driven Account Executive to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be the face of Develocity for enterprise prospects and customers in the New York and East Coast US region, focusing on driving revenue growth and new business acquisition. You'll act as a primary point of contact for our enterprise accounts in your territory. Your goal will be to guide these organizations on their journey with Develocity to unlock comprehensive data throughout the build process, empowering you to detect the unknown unknowns so you can ship faster, reduce risk, and lower costs, all while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be responsible for formulating and executing a sales strategy to grow your territory and acquire new customers. Responsibilities As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth. You will do this by: Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams. Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals. Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives. Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close. Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product. Mastering sales techniques like MEDPICC and Command of the Message to execute deals effectively. Attending industry events and Develocity-hosted sessions to strengthen relationships and generate new business. Analyzing wins and losses and sharing insights with internal teams to improve our approach. Documenting best practices in our sales playbook to contribute to continuous improvement. Being willing to travel to meet customers in person. Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of direct sales experience selling enterprise software to executives in large, complex organizations. A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quotas. Experience in the DevOps, Observability, or CI/CD space. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present to C-level executives. Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. Knowledge of MEDDPICC is a plus. Willingness to travel. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the following sales tools: Salesforce, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, and Gong. AI-first mindset to help with automating everyday tasks.  What We Offer Ability to work in a remote-first environment with flexible working hours. Work on a fast-growing product with a clear vision for the future. Close collaboration with an ambitious and experienced team and the opportunity to learn from them regardless of your experience level. Opportunities for growth in your career and in leadership responsibilities. In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite team meetings, and onboardings. Contribute to leading solutions in the new industry of Developer Productivity Engineering and work with cutting-edge DPE tools and practices. Competitive salaries and equity grants. Location Remote from Europe. While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Responsibilities

As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth.

  • Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams.
  • Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals.
  • Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives.

  • Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product.

  • Attending industry events and Develocity-hosted sessions to strengthen relationships and generate new business.

  • Documenting best practices in our sales playbook to contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Being willing to travel to meet customers in person.

  • Experience in the DevOps, Observability, or CI/CD space.

  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. Knowledge of MEDDPICC is a plus.

working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended,&nbsp;what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual&nbsp;request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to&nbsp;finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this&nbsp;team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk&nbsp;through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>The France Based </strong>Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.</p><p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Refer them!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About the role

We're looking for two Payment Support Coordinators to join our Expert Services & Operations (ES&O) team on a short-term contract basis. You'll work directly on our linguist payment queue, helping to clear a backlog of payment requests and restoring a reliable, responsive experience for our global network of expert linguists.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You'll be triaging, investigating, and resolving payment issues across multiple systems, working closely with our existing coordinators and escalating to finance and engineering where needed.

What you'll be doing

  • Triaging and responding to incoming payment support tickets in Jira, prioritising by urgency and issue type

  • Investigating payment failures, discrepancies, and delays across the Lilt platform, Tipalti, Salesforce, and third-party processors (PayPal, Payoneer)

  • Resolving common issues including: Tipalti profile corrections, 2FA resets, banking detail mismatches, and manual offline payment (OPM) re-logging

  • Communicating clearly and empathetically with linguists to gather information and provide timely updates

  • Escalating technical breakages (e.g. platform stats sync issues) and rate discrepancies to the relevant internal teams

  • Maintaining accurate ticket notes and contributing to weekly reporting on queue volume and SLA adherence

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a payments, finance operations, or customer/vendor support role

  • Comfortable working across multiple systems simultaneously (Jira, Salesforce, or similar)

  • Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills — you'll be dealing with complex, sometimes sensitive payment disputes

  • Able to work independently, manage a high-volume queue, and know when to escalate

  • Experience with Tipalti or international payment platforms is a strong plus

  • Fluency in English required; additional languages are a bonus given our global linguist community

What to expect

This is a contract role. You'll be joining a small, collaborative ES&O team and will have clear ownership of a defined portion of the queue from day one.

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

LILT's mission is to make the world's information available to everyone, no matter the language they speak. Join our global community who thrive on innovation and excellence. Our collective knowledge, uniqueness, and skills deliver multilingual AI and human-verified services to Enterprises, Governments, and AI Developers around the world.

Earn money. Have fun. Advance human knowledge. Work on diverse projects from anywhere, any time you want. Get paid quickly and fairly, and build your professional network in a supportive community—all through a streamlined application process tailored to your expertise.

Information collected and processed as part of your application process, including any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to LILT's Privacy Policy at https://lilt.com/legal/privacy.

These tools are designed to support human decision-making and help us identify qualified candidates efficiently and objectively. All final hiring decisions are made by people. raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><div> <h3><strong>The Challenge</strong></h3> <p>At OneTrust, we’re on a mission to help organizations use data and technology responsibly. As a <strong>Strategic Account Executive</strong>, you will play a pivotal role in driving new business growth while expanding relationships within some of our most important enterprise accounts in <strong>France and Switzerland</strong>.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, consultative sales role focused on engaging senior decision-makers, solving complex business challenges, and delivering meaningful outcomes for customers. You'll join a fast-growing SaaS company that invests heavily in its sales organization through world-class training, proven methodologies, strong demand generation, executive sponsorship, and customer-led innovation.</p> <p>If you thrive on creating opportunities, navigating complex sales cycles, and winning strategic enterprise deals, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact.</p> <h3><strong>Your Mission</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Strategic Account Executive</strong>, you will be responsible for generating, developing, and closing opportunities that help organizations build trust in an increasingly complex business environment while driving revenue growth for OneTrust.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, leveraging your industry expertise, business acumen, and value-based selling skills to uncover customer needs, solve strategic challenges, and position OneTrust as a long-term partner.</p> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets and performance goals.</li> <li>Build, manage, and advance a healthy pipeline through strategic prospecting and account development.</li> <li>Balance new business acquisition with expansion opportunities within existing accounts.</li> <li>Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through contract execution.</li> <li>Deliver compelling value-based presentations, demonstrations, and business cases.</li> <li>Develop executive-level relationships and establish credibility with C-suite decision makers.</li> <li>Partner closely with Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner teams to execute account strategies.</li> <li>Understand customer priorities and translate them into tailored solutions that deliver measurable business value.</li> <li>Maintain deep knowledge of market trends, competitive positioning, and industry best practices.</li> <li>Manage and optimize a defined strategic territory to maximize long-term growth opportunities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You Are</strong></h3> <p>You are a highly motivated enterprise sales professional with a hunter mentality and a passion for solving complex customer challenges. You are equally comfortable opening new doors, engaging executive stakeholders, and navigating sophisticated sales cycles.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>A consultative and strategic approach to enterprise selling.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.</li> <li>The ability to influence and engage senior executives across multiple functions.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset.</li> <li>Curiosity, authenticity, integrity, and a commitment to continuous learning.</li> <li>A disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM excellence.</li> <li>Resourcefulness in identifying key stakeholders, champions, and decision-makers to drive successful outcomes.</li> <li>The ability to balance prospecting activities with advancing and closing opportunities.</li> <li>A collaborative mindset and proven success working across cross-functional teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience selling enterprise B2B SaaS solutions or related technology platforms, ideally 12+ years.</li> <li>Proven track record of exceeding sales targets through both net-new customer acquisition and strategic account growth.</li> <li>Experience with value-based and consultative selling methodologies.</li> <li>Strong executive presence with demonstrated success selling to C-level stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience leading enterprise sales presentations, workshops, and product demonstrations.</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce.com or similar CRM platforms.</li> <li>Experience managing complex, multi-threaded sales opportunities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in Privacy, Security, Third-Party Risk Management, Governance, Risk &amp; Compliance (GRC), or related markets.</li> <li>Experience selling directly into Information Security, Risk, Compliance, or Privacy organizations.</li> <li>CIPP/E and/or CIPM certification.</li> <li>Training in Command of the Message or similar enterprise sales methodologies.</li> <li>Fluent in French and English</li> </ul> <p>Join OneTrust and help organizations around the world become more trusted while accelerating your career in one of the fastest-growing software companies in the industry.</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><span class="TextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">Where we Work</span></span></h3> <p>We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.</p> <p>Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.</p> <h3><span class="TextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">Benefits</span></span></h3> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">As an employee at&nbsp;</span><span class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW202854797 BCX0">OneTrust</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">, you will be part of the </span><span class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW202854797 BCX0">OneTeam</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">. That means </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">you’ll</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0"> receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. raw.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE RÔLE

Au sein du pôle Développement Maroquinerie, le/la Chef(fe) de produit est garant(e), du développement des produits et du suivi des collections. En lien direct avec la Responsable Développement Maroquinerie, il/elle intervient de manière autonome sur l'ensemble de son périmètre, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes, Création Produit, Merchandising et Production.

 

VOS MISSIONS  

  • Travail en autonomie sur les offres maroquinerie homme, petite maroquinerie, ceintures et projets VIP
  • Accompagnement des fabricants dans le développement des produits, sur la base du brief du studio et du brief merchandising, déplacements sur site à prévoir
  • Gestion du parc de fabricants en collaboration avec l’équipe production (identification des forces et faiblesses, contretype)
  • Propositions d’alternatives techniques auprès du studio et des fabricants, pour anticiper les problématiques industrialisation et costing dans le respect de l’intention créative
  • Pilotage du développement des prototypes et des échantillons dans le respect des délais, de la marge et du niveau de qualité
  • Visibilité prix tout au long de la collection et négociations dans le respect des objectifs de marge
  • En charge du référencements produits et garant de l’exactitude des nomenclatures produits
  • Mise à jour des plans de collection et outils de suivi de collections
  • Support argumentaires spécificités produits pour l’équipe merchandising
  • Gestion planning shooting packshot et conformité produit en lien avec l’équipe image
  • Participation aux organisations défilé (pointage collection, mises en place produit pour editing styling et fitting, packing collection)
  • Préparation et transmission des dossiers techniques aux équipes industrialisation et production.
  • Validations facture et suivi rigoureux des coûts engagés
  • Participation à l’amélioration en continue des process

 

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Bac +3 à Bac +5 (commerce, mode ou équivalent), avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement produit maroquinerie et/ou petite maroquinerie, idéalement dans l'univers du luxe ou de la mode

 

  • Bonne connaissance du marché et de ses acteurs

 

  • Expérience en gestion fabricants, développement produits et analyse de dossiers techniques

 

  • Maîtrise d'Excel et des outils bureautiques ; connaissance d'un ERP/PLM fortement appréciée

 

  • Anglais professionnel indispensable, italien fortement apprécié

 

  • Forte sensibilité produit alliée à une organisation rigoureuse et un bon sens des priorités

 

  • Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, proactivité, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités

Dans ce contexte d’accélération, le Groupe recrute un/une Chargé(e) d’Administration RH afin de sécuriser et de professionnaliser l’ensemble des processus administratifs liés au cycle de paie et à l’expérience interne des Illuiners. La paie est externalisée auprès d’un prestataire : votre rôle n’est pas de la produire mais d’en assurer la préparation, le contrôle et la coordination de bout en bout. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile, dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de rigueur, de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que : Pilotage et contrôle de la paie externalisée Collecte, consolidation et transmission des éléments variables de paie au prestataire (entrées/sorties, absences, variables, primes, notes de frais impactant la paie) selon un calendrier de paie maîtrisé ; Contrôle de la saisie des temps par les salariés (suivi des congés etc) ; Collecte des déclarations sociales produites par le prestataire (DSN, charges sociales, organismes de prévoyance et de mutuelle) et suivi des éventuelles anomalies jusqu’à résolution ; Rapprochement de la paie avec la comptabilité en lien avec le CFO et l’expert comptable (écritures de paie, provisions congés payés, comptes de tiers sociaux). Administration du personnel et cycle de vie collaborateur Gestion administrative des entrées : DPAE, rédaction des contrats et avenants, affiliations mutuelle et prévoyance, visites médicales, création des dossiers collaborateurs ; Suivi des évolutions en cours de vie (avenants, mobilités, changements de temps de travail) et des sorties (documents de fin de contrat, coordination avec la paie et le management) ; Suivi des absences, congés, arrêts de travail, IJSS et dossiers de prévoyance ; Gestion des dispositifs collectifs et avantages (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, mobilité durable, remboursements transport) ; Tenue et fiabilisation des obligations administratives : registre unique du personnel, affichages, archivage et conformité RGPD des données sociales. Coordination des prestataires et interlocuteurs externes Interlocuteur(trice) de référence du cabinet de paie : animation du rythme de collaboration, cadrage des livrables, respect des échéances et arbitrage des points bloquants ; Point de contact avec les organismes externes (URSSAF, organismes de retraite et de prévoyance, médecine du travail, OPCO, mutuelle) en lien avec le prestataire et le CFO; Data & Process Owner RH Élaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus administratifs RH et de l’outillage associé (SIRH), dans un contexte de croissance et avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ; Garantie de la qualité et de la cohérence de la donnée sociale entre le SIRH, la paie et les outils Finance. Conformité sociale et missions ponctuelles Veille sur la réglementation sociale et l’application de la convention collective, avec appui de conseils externes sur les sujets complexes ; Contribution aux obligations et échéances annuelles (index égalité professionnelle, déclarations obligatoires, préparation des audits) ; Participation aux projets de structuration de la fonction People : déploiement ou évolution du SIRH, automatisation des processus, préparation des instances représentatives du personnel. Profil Recherché Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun. Formation en Ressources Humaines, gestion de la paie ou droit social (Licence/Master, titre professionnel gestionnaire de paie) Une expérience confirmée en administration du personnel et en gestion ou contrôle de la paie, en entreprise ou en cabinet Bonne connaissance des mécanismes de paie et du cadre légal et conventionnel français ; une connaissance de la convention Syntec est un plus Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils SIRH, l’automatisation des processus et l'A appliquée aux fonctions support Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur et d’un sens aigu de la confidentialité. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique, ainsi que d’un vrai sens du service auprès des collaborateurs. Ce que propose le poste Un rôle central et à forte visibilité, au contact de l’ensemble des collaborateurs et en lien direct avec la Direction, Un périmètre complet, de la paie à l’administration du personnel, La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro, en proposant les outils et les processus qui structureront la fonction People. raw.title: Chef de Projet Fonctionnel – Migration Comptable (Télétravail complet possible)
raw.description:
Et si ton expertise comptable devenait le pont entre les cabinets et la technologie qui va transformer leur métier ?

Chez Pennylane, on a une conviction forte : les experts-comptables méritent des outils à la hauteur de leur métier. Des outils qui leur font gagner du temps sur les tâches répétitives, pour qu'ils puissent se concentrer sur ce qui compte vraiment : le conseil, l'accompagnement, la relation client. C'est pour ça qu'on a construit une plateforme tout-en-un qui réunit experts-comptables et dirigeants sur le même outil.

Aujourd’hui, nous recrutons une personne ayant exercé comme collaborateur ou collaboratrice comptable en cabinet, ayant déjà participé idéalement à une ou plusieurs migrations vers un nouveau logiciel comptable. Ta connaissance du métier et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de les accompagner au mieux dans la migration de leurs données comptables vers Pennylane.

🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ?

Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible

🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

🎯 Ton rôle

Tu rejoins l'équipe Partner Solutions Specialists, composée intégralement d'anciens comptables. Une équipe qui comprend les enjeux des cabinets de l'intérieur, et qui les accompagne avec le bon niveau d'expertise métier, de rigueur et d'empathie.

En tant que PSS Front, tu es l'expert métier en contact direct avec toutes les parties prenantes pendant les projets de migration. Tu travailles en binôme avec le PSS Back (Partner Solutions Architect), qui prend en charge l'intégration et les aspects techniques. Toi, tu es le visage du projet côté cabinet : celui ou celle qui cadre, qui rassure, qui fait avancer.

C'est un rôle exigeant, au croisement de la gestion de projet, de l'expertise comptable et de la relation client, avec une vraie dimension de conseil et d'amélioration continue.

📋 Tes missions au quotidien

Audit et analyse des besoins fonctionnels

  • Planifier, préparer et animer les réunions avec les cabinets — du lancement au Retex, en passant par les briefings, cadrages et restitutions

  • Analyser les besoins métiers à partir des retours terrain et des expériences de migration

  • Rédiger la documentation et les user stories pour faciliter la compréhension des autres équipes

  • Animer des ateliers et webinaires — certains centrés sur les usages métiers, d'autres plus transverses

Gestion de projet de migration

  • S'assurer que les migrations suivent un cheminement clair et documenté, pour toutes les parties prenantes (internes et externes)

  • Adapter la démarche en fonction des situations, tout en veillant au respect des process existants pour garantir une vraie collaboration inter-équipes

  • Communiquer régulièrement sur l'alignement entre les solutions techniques et les besoins métiers

  • Être le relais d'information vers le PSS Back, en charge de l'intégration, de la correction et du contrôle

Préparation métier et paramétrage

  • Contribuer à la configuration de Pennylane pour l'adapter aux processus métiers existants des cabinets

  • Participer aux tests fonctionnels pour valider que la solution répond aux exigences métiers avant la migration

Support post-migration et recettes

  • Collaborer avec les équipes PSS Back sur le débogage et la résolution des problèmes métiers après migration

  • Conduire des tests fonctionnels intermédiaires et finaux pour valider les solutions

  • Contribuer aux rapports post-migration et proposer des axes d'amélioration

Automatisation et optimisation des processus

  • Identifier et prioriser les besoins en automatisation et en optimisation

  • Participer à leur mise en œuvre via de la documentation, des feedbacks ou des propositions concrètes

  • Suivre la satisfaction métier après chaque évolution

Veille, R&D et amélioration continue

  • Assurer une veille produit et métier pour garantir la pertinence des fonctionnalités

  • Proposer des améliorations sur l'existant et signaler les manques ou dysfonctionnements

  • Contribuer à la transformation des besoins en solutions actionnables, pour l'interne comme pour l'externe

Collaboration Front / Back

  • Connaître les enjeux des tâches du PSS Back et pouvoir intervenir ponctuellement sur la production selon les besoins

🙋 Le profil qu'on recherche

  • Formation comptable : IUT GEA, BTS CGO, DCG, DSCG, Master CCA — tu as les bases solides

  • Expérience en cabinet d'expertise-comptable, idéalement avec une ou plusieurs migrations déjà vécues

  • À l'aise à l'oral comme à l'écrit, tu interagis avec les comptables de manière claire, professionnelle et crédible

  • Sens du service et de la relation client : tu comprends les besoins, tu y réponds, et tu entretiens une vraie relation de confiance dans la durée

  • Capable de travailler en autonomie comme en équipe, avec une vraie flexibilité pour t'adapter aux évolutions rapides du produit

  • Envie d'apprendre en continu et de rester à jour sur les évolutions fonctionnelles de Pennylane

  • Anglais niveau A2 minimum

Les "nice to have"

  • À l'aise dans un environnement startup

  • Anglais niveau B1

  • Bon esprit de synthèse et vraie pédagogie

  • Proactivité et autonomie marquées

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange avec un Business Recruiter — pour se découvrir et poser les bases

  2. Un entretien avec un Team Leader PSS — pour rentrer dans le fond du poste

  3. Un cas pratique avec un Partner Solutions Specialist — pour voir comment tu travailles concrètement

  4. Une dernière rencontre avec le ou la Head of Partner Success — pour valider l'alignement sur la vision et la culture

 

🎁 Ce que l'on peut t'offrir

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 8 et 13 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d'accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint-Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃 Un accès à 8 000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Des Tech Days tous les 3 mois pour que les Pennylaners en remote se retrouvent, et un séminaire annuel pour vivre de grands moments de cohésion

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra :

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du poste)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une vraie priorité — avec ton équipe comme avec les autres parties prenantes

  • Savoir prendre du recul pour prioriser les actions à fort impact dans son activité quotidienne

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. On sait que les profils les plus intéressants sont rarement des copies conformes d'une fiche de poste. Ce qui compte, c'est ta trajectoire, ta façon de penser, et l'envie de contribuer à quelque chose qui a du sens.

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d'arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l'adresse e-mail de l'expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles @pennylane.com ou @pennylane-partners.com.

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d'informations financières dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s'agit d'une fraude — ne répondez pas et signalez-le nous immédiatement.

Encourageant la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l'épanouissement. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. As a Business Development Representative intern, you'll be on the front line of our growth engine. Your job is to generate qualified meetings with healthcare leaders who are overwhelmed by missed calls and inefficiencies, and show them how Vocca can change the game.

You'll hunt, qualify, and open doors so our Account Executives can close. You'll learn how to prospect like a pro, pitch like a consultant, and build the foundations of a sales career — with the goal of joining us full-time at the end of your internship.

Expected outcomes

1 month:

  • Master our pitch, our CRM, and our outbound playbook.

  • Book your first qualified meetings with healthcare prospects.

3 months:

  • Consistently hit monthly meeting targets through a mix of outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.

  • Own inbound qualification: every lead gets a fast, thoughtful response.

  • Share field insights with Sales & Marketing to improve targeting.

End of internship (5-6 months):

  • Be performing at or near full quota, ready to hit the ground running as a full-time BDR.

  • Have tested and proposed new outbound tactics (copy, sequences, channels).

  • Convert to a full-time contract (CDI) if you perform well.

Who you are
This is for you if:

  • You're ambitious, competitive, and hungry to prove yourself.

  • You thrive on challenges and don't shy away from the grind of outbound sales.

  • You have excellent communication skills: clear, confident, and persuasive.

  • You're coachable and eager to learn: you want feedback, you act on it fast.

  • You're resilient: every "no" just brings you closer to a "yes."

  • You're in your final year of business school, engineering school, or equivalent, looking for an end-of-studies internship (convention de stage required), and open to converting to full-time.

It's a plus if you:

  • Have experience in sales, retail, hospitality, or any role where convincing and resilience were key.

  • Already used Attio (CRM).

Career perspectives

  • Learn modern sales from the ground up in a fast-growing AI startup.

  • Be coached directly by the founders & early sales leaders.

  • Fast-track to a full-time BDR role at the end of your internship, with a clear path: SDR → AE → Sales Leader.

Hiring Process
Intro interview (20 min) — with our Recruiter, to get to know each other and confirm alignment.

  • HM interview (20 min) — with one person from the Sales Team, to get to know each other and confirm alignment.

  • Situational interview (45 min) — with 2 sales from the team: targeted questions + sales role-play + debrief.

  • Founders interview (30 min) — with the Head of Sales, to discuss vision, culture, and ambition.

  • Offer! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.
